limits: Ordinary run variance is acceptable; percentages alone do not establish a regression.
Windows native performance comparisons are unavailable because the current workload monitor requires POSIX process enumeration.
Native scenarios start after an active photo and the graphics device have loaded. They do not measure cold process startup or screen scanout.
Repeated edits may reuse upstream results, so they do not establish fresh ColorField recomputation costs.
Actual grid, settings, geometry and cache policy are in matched workload keys. Catalog names do not establish resolution.
Physical footprint uses nominal 100 ms samples. These are observed trial maxima, not guaranteed transient peaks or settled physical memory.
Retained CPU/GPU/reserved inventories are logical ownership. They are not measured VRAM and must not be added to process footprint.
All initial and reversed observations remain separate. No favorable trial selection or automatic release clearance.
Raw reports and memory samples remain separate evidence. This compact summary is not a raw regression.json input to compare.py.

processing_output_evidence.scope: Reviewed optimization before the application version bump; headless proof on the same processing sources, not a new image replay of the downloaded GUI archives.

coverage_gaps: The full native GUI acceptance catalog and1,440-case slider matrix were not rerun for 0.8.3. Exact-package workspace smoke passed on both desktops.
Windows native performance comparisons remain unavailable with the current POSIX workload monitor.
Runtime Windows evidence is Windows 11 Home build 26200. Windows 10 was not tested.
macOS 15 CI checked signed executable loading via help, not native graphics or interactive GUI.
The historical hosted parallel native access violation remains unresolved. Serial gates passing does not establish a fix. Prior 0.8.2 risk acceptance does not authorize 0.8.3 publication.

setup_attempts.cause: staged source archive lacked Git index required for source hashing
setup_attempts.correction: initialize staged Git index and rerun into a distinct final directory

setup_attempts.cause: render-case CLI options were incorrectly treated as a settings recipe
setup_attempts.correction: use the checked-in prior-release explicit ColorField recipe and rerun into a distinct final directory

findings: All 12 catalog workloads, two enabled-feature comparisons and both reversed confirmations have matching workload identities. No automatic performance budget was applied.
HDR median warm-edit latency fell from 58.796 to 53.887 ms in these production-package trials. This is a scoped observation, not a general application speedup.

The first ColorField initial-selection median rose 97.215 ms, with lower p95. Five reversed trials reduced the median difference to 29.261 ms and retained a slightly lower p95. Between-run baseline variation was larger. No uniform ColorField slowdown was established.
The first memory-pressure action median rose 7.391 ms. Reversed trials instead improved by 1.555 ms, with a lower p95 in both observations.

Median sampled physical-footprint peak changes were -1.87% HDR, +0.60% ColorField, -0.14% multi-photo and +0.65% native-detail. These samples do not establish settled process footprint or memory equivalence.
The earlier private-candidate HDR footprint gap did not recur in these matched production-package trials. No fixed additional allocation cost was established.
Draft packaging and native smoke are complete. Full 0.8.3 publication clearance and owner risk decisions remain open.
